vibes.name: Commanding

vibes.name: Urgent

vibes.name: Hustled

vibes.name: Irreverent

vibes.name: Compassionate

vibes.name: Coaxing
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; concealed intent gently steers the target.

vibes.name: Steadfast

vibes.name: Boundaried

vibes.name: Communal

vibes.name: Deflecting
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; emotional recognition redirects attention or avoids the real issue.

vibes.name: Bluffing
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; hostility is projected through uncertain or false threat.

vibes.name: Predatory
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; concealed intent advances toward an exposed weakness.

vibes.name: Insinuating

vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; emotional reading becomes judgment, guilt, or moral accusation.

vibes.name: Extortive
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; concealed or ambiguous leverage controls the target.

vibes.name: Menacing
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; hostility makes the advance threatening.

vibes.name: Commanding
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; social fluency makes direction feel authoritative.

vibes.name: Urgent
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; recognized stakes make action immediate and emotionally legible.

vibes.name: Hustled
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; obscured terms and compressed time prevent scrutiny.

vibes.name: Irreverent
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; antagonism appears as insolence, teasing, mockery, or social trespass.

vibes.name: Charismatic
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; confidence and forward motion turn charm into momentum.

vibes.name: Compassionate
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; emotional care makes the bond supportive and sincere.

vibes.name: Coaxing
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; concealed intent gently steers the target.

vibes.name: Steadfast
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; opposition makes the speaker emotionally aware but immovable.

vibes.name: Boundaried
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; decisive force establishes a clear limit or next move.

vibes.name: Communal
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; affiliation turns shared feeling into collective action.

vibes.name: Deflecting
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; emotional recognition redirects attention or avoids the real issue.

vibes.name: Bluffing
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; hostility is projected through uncertain or false threat.

vibes.name: Predatory
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; concealed intent advances toward an exposed weakness.

vibes.name: Insinuating
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretation leads; implication travels through friendly or social framing.

vibes.name: Feigning
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; simulated understanding or care conceals the real motive.

vibes.name: Reckless
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; forward force makes it rash, volatile, and ready to act.

vibes.name: Instigating
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; social awareness turns it into bait, spectacle, or provocation.

vibes.name: Condemning
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; emotional reading becomes judgment, guilt, or moral accusation.

vibes.name: Extortive
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; concealed or ambiguous leverage controls the target.

vibes.name: Menacing
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; hostility makes the advance threatening.

vibes.name: Commanding
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; social fluency makes direction feel authoritative.

vibes.name: Urgent
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; recognized stakes make action immediate and emotionally legible.

vibes.name: Hustled
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; obscured terms and compressed time prevent scrutiny.

vibes.name: Irreverent
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; antagonism appears as insolence, teasing, mockery, or social trespass.

vibes.name: Charismatic
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; confidence and forward motion turn charm into momentum.

vibes.name: Compassionate
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; emotional care makes the bond supportive and sincere.

vibes.name: Coaxing
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; concealed intent gently steers the target.

vibes.name: Steadfast
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; opposition makes the speaker emotionally aware but immovable.

vibes.name: Boundaried
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; decisive force establishes a clear limit or next move.

vibes.name: Communal
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; affiliation turns shared feeling into collective action.

vibes.name: Deflecting
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; emotional recognition redirects attention or avoids the real issue.

vibes.name: Bluffing
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; hostility is projected through uncertain or false threat.

vibes.name: Predatory
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; concealed intent advances toward an exposed weakness.

vibes.name: Insinuating
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretation leads; implication travels through friendly or social framing.

vibes.name: Feigning
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; simulated understanding or care conceals the real motive.

events.playerText: Okay… Here's today's depot header and signature on my counterfoil. I'm keeping the detail covered. Does the source check out?
events.marcusText: The header and signature check out. I know where the paper came from. What it means is another question.
events.feedback: The document's source checks out. The exact detail remains private. A genuine document does not by itself prove a useful deal or wrongdoing.

receiving.visibleCaption: Both brows rise; the eyes face forward while the mouth stays closed.

responding.visibleCaption: Both brows lift above forward-looking eyes; the mouth holds a restrained smile.

events.playerText: All right… Would a count mismatch on paper matter for the stock record?
events.marcusText: Show me a specific mismatch and it's worth checking. That alone wouldn't tell me who's responsible.
events.feedback: You have an indication that this category matters to his current business, not a complete read of what he values. The exact detail is still yours to disclose or retain.

events.playerText: Okay… You said the signed intake summary was reconciled. Could the count still be wrong?
events.marcusText: The intake was signed off. If there is a specific discrepancy, it can be checked. A question alone does not settle it.
events.feedback: You questioned the intake record; that does not establish blame. Checking the source and its relevance can help you decide how to handle the detail you still hold. No concession is promised.

receiving.visibleCaption: The inner brows rise above forward-looking eyes; the lips form a small rounded opening.

responding.visibleCaption: Both brows flatten above forward-looking eyes; one corner of the mouth turns down.

events.playerText: All right… Here is the exact detail I have: Counterfoil R-17 records six crates returned against stock ledger entry L-42's eight: a two-crate mismatch. It does not establish theft or who caused the error. What do you make of it?
events.marcusText: I need to check that count. Give me an offer that adds up while I look into it. We don't have a deal yet.
events.feedback: The checked mismatch unsettles his reliance on the summary. He is open to a defensible proposal while he sorts it out. Use the next DEAL within the next three turns; it is a brief opportunity, not agreement.

receiving.visibleCaption: Both brows rise; the eyes face forward while the mouth stays closed.

vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; emotional reading becomes judgment, guilt, or moral accusation.

vibes.name: Extortive
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; concealed or ambiguous leverage controls the target.

vibes.name: Menacing
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; hostility makes the advance threatening.

vibes.name: Commanding
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; social fluency makes direction feel authoritative.

vibes.name: Urgent
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; recognized stakes make action immediate and emotionally legible.

vibes.name: Hustled
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; obscured terms and compressed time prevent scrutiny.

vibes.name: Irreverent
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; antagonism appears as insolence, teasing, mockery, or social trespass.

vibes.name: Charismatic
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; confidence and forward motion turn charm into momentum.

vibes.name: Compassionate
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; emotional care makes the bond supportive and sincere.

vibes.name: Coaxing
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; concealed intent gently steers the target.

vibes.name: Steadfast
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; opposition makes the speaker emotionally aware but immovable.

vibes.name: Boundaried
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; decisive force establishes a clear limit or next move.

vibes.name: Communal
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; affiliation turns shared feeling into collective action.

vibes.name: Deflecting
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; emotional recognition redirects attention or avoids the real issue.

vibes.name: Bluffing
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; hostility is projected through uncertain or false threat.

vibes.name: Predatory
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; concealed intent advances toward an exposed weakness.

vibes.name: Insinuating
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretation leads; implication travels through friendly or social framing.

vibes.name: Feigning
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; simulated understanding or care conceals the real motive.

vibes.name: Instigating

vibes.name: Condemning
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; emotional reading becomes judgment, guilt, or moral accusation.

vibes.name: Extortive
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; concealed or ambiguous leverage controls the target.

vibes.name: Menacing
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; hostility makes the advance threatening.

vibes.name: Commanding
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; social fluency makes direction feel authoritative.

vibes.name: Urgent
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; recognized stakes make action immediate and emotionally legible.

vibes.name: Hustled
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; obscured terms and compressed time prevent scrutiny.

vibes.name: Irreverent
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; antagonism appears as insolence, teasing, mockery, or social trespass.

vibes.name: Charismatic
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; confidence and forward motion turn charm into momentum.

vibes.name: Compassionate
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; emotional care makes the bond supportive and sincere.

vibes.name: Coaxing
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; concealed intent gently steers the target.

vibes.name: Steadfast
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; opposition makes the speaker emotionally aware but immovable.

vibes.name: Boundaried
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; decisive force establishes a clear limit or next move.

vibes.name: Communal
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; affiliation turns shared feeling into collective action.

vibes.name: Deflecting
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; emotional recognition redirects attention or avoids the real issue.

vibes.name: Bluffing
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; hostility is projected through uncertain or false threat.

vibes.name: Predatory
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; concealed intent advances toward an exposed weakness.

vibes.name: Insinuating
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretation leads; implication travels through friendly or social framing.

vibes.name: Feigning
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; simulated understanding or care conceals the real motive.

vibes.name: Communal

vibes.name: Deflecting

vibes.name: Reckless
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; forward force makes it rash, volatile, and ready to act.

vibes.name: Instigating
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; social awareness turns it into bait, spectacle, or provocation.

vibes.name: Condemning
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; emotional reading becomes judgment, guilt, or moral accusation.

vibes.name: Extortive
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; concealed or ambiguous leverage controls the target.

vibes.name: Menacing
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; hostility makes the advance threatening.

vibes.name: Commanding
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; social fluency makes direction feel authoritative.

vibes.name: Urgent
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; recognized stakes make action immediate and emotionally legible.

vibes.name: Hustled
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; obscured terms and compressed time prevent scrutiny.

vibes.name: Irreverent
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; antagonism appears as insolence, teasing, mockery, or social trespass.

vibes.name: Charismatic
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; confidence and forward motion turn charm into momentum.

vibes.name: Compassionate
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; emotional care makes the bond supportive and sincere.

vibes.name: Coaxing
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; concealed intent gently steers the target.

vibes.name: Steadfast
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; opposition makes the speaker emotionally aware but immovable.

vibes.name: Boundaried
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; decisive force establishes a clear limit or next move.

vibes.name: Communal
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; affiliation turns shared feeling into collective action.

vibes.name: Deflecting
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; emotional recognition redirects attention or avoids the real issue.

vibes.name: Bluffing
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; hostility is projected through uncertain or false threat.

vibes.name: Predatory
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; concealed intent advances toward an exposed weakness.

vibes.name: Insinuating
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretation leads; implication travels through friendly or social framing.

vibes.name: Feigning
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; simulated understanding or care conceals the real motive.

vibes.name: Instigating

vibes.name: Condemning
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; emotional reading becomes judgment, guilt, or moral accusation.

vibes.name: Extortive
vibes.fusionLogic: Opposition leads; concealed or ambiguous leverage controls the target.

vibes.name: Menacing
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; hostility makes the advance threatening.

vibes.name: Commanding
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; social fluency makes direction feel authoritative.

vibes.name: Urgent
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; recognized stakes make action immediate and emotionally legible.

vibes.name: Hustled
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; obscured terms and compressed time prevent scrutiny.

vibes.name: Irreverent
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; antagonism appears as insolence, teasing, mockery, or social trespass.

vibes.name: Charismatic
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; confidence and forward motion turn charm into momentum.

vibes.name: Compassionate
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; emotional care makes the bond supportive and sincere.

vibes.name: Coaxing
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; concealed intent gently steers the target.

vibes.name: Steadfast
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; opposition makes the speaker emotionally aware but immovable.

vibes.name: Boundaried
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; decisive force establishes a clear limit or next move.

vibes.name: Communal
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; affiliation turns shared feeling into collective action.

vibes.name: Deflecting
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; emotional recognition redirects attention or avoids the real issue.

vibes.name: Bluffing
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; hostility is projected through uncertain or false threat.

vibes.name: Predatory
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; concealed intent advances toward an exposed weakness.

vibes.name: Insinuating
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretation leads; implication travels through friendly or social framing.

vibes.name: Extortive

vibes.name: Menacing

vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; social fluency makes direction feel authoritative.

vibes.name: Urgent
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; recognized stakes make action immediate and emotionally legible.

vibes.name: Hustled
vibes.fusionLogic: Forward movement leads; obscured terms and compressed time prevent scrutiny.

vibes.name: Irreverent
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; antagonism appears as insolence, teasing, mockery, or social trespass.

vibes.name: Charismatic
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; confidence and forward motion turn charm into momentum.

vibes.name: Compassionate

vibes.name: Coaxing
vibes.fusionLogic: Rapport leads; concealed intent gently steers the target.

vibes.name: Steadfast
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; opposition makes the speaker emotionally aware but immovable.

vibes.name: Boundaried
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; decisive force establishes a clear limit or next move.

vibes.name: Communal
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; affiliation turns shared feeling into collective action.

vibes.name: Deflecting
vibes.fusionLogic: Understanding leads; emotional recognition redirects attention or avoids the real issue.

vibes.name: Bluffing
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; hostility is projected through uncertain or false threat.

vibes.name: Predatory
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; concealed intent advances toward an exposed weakness.

vibes.name: Insinuating
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretation leads; implication travels through friendly or social framing.

vibes.name: Feigning
vibes.fusionLogic: Interpretive control leads; simulated understanding or care conceals the real motive.

events.feedback: The document's source checks out. The exact detail remains private. A genuine document does not by itself prove a useful deal or wrongdoing.

events.playerText: All right… Would a count mismatch on paper matter for the stock record?
events.marcusText: Show me a specific mismatch and it's worth checking. That alone wouldn't tell me who's responsible.
events.feedback: You have an indication that this category matters to his current business, not a complete read of what he values. The exact detail is still yours to disclose or retain.

events.feedback: You questioned the intake record; that does not establish blame. Checking the source and its relevance can help you decide how to handle the detail you still hold. No concession is promised.

receiving.visibleCaption: The inner brows rise above forward-looking eyes; the lips form a small rounded opening.

events.marcusText: I need to check that count. Give me an offer that adds up while I look into it. We don't have a deal yet.
events.feedback: The checked mismatch unsettles his reliance on the summary. He is open to a defensible proposal while he sorts it out. Use the next DEAL within the next three turns; it is a brief opportunity, not agreement.

events.playerText: All right… I accept the current offer: 2 Contra units, $50 upfront, $70 in new credit plus $12 extra due in 7 days. My existing debt remains separate.
